rationale: This record is a journal book review (Castro reviewing Viqueira and Saldaña eds., 2009) of an edited volume on the history and theory of agricultural irrigation water administration ('la administración del agua de riego'). It fails Criterion 1 (E07 wrong service: agricultural irrigation rather than household or community drinking water or sanitation service access), Criterion 3 (book review rather than empirical primary research or a systematic synthesis), and Criterion 4 (no household/community water or sanitation access outcomes).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both the narrow rule-type reading and the plain wording of Criterion 2 result in exclusion because the record concerns agricultural irrigation water ('agua de riego') rather than household or community water/sanitation service access, and the publication itself is a book review rather than an empirical primary study or systematic review.
